summary.label: Latest suite

cases.label: Eval cases
cases.empty: No eval cases yet. A case is a diff plus the findings a review must (or must not) produce.
cases.legacyTitle: This case's expected output predates skill evals and does not parse, so suites skip it. Edit it to add expectations.

outcomeTitle.caught: Passes only with the skill: the skill caught it.
outcomeTitle.regressed: Passes only without the skill: the skill made it worse.
outcomeTitle.pass_both: Passes with and without the skill.
outcomeTitle.fail_both: Fails with and without the skill.
outcomeTitle.flaky: Repeats disagree within one arm; excluded from caught and regressed.
outcomeTitle.error: At least one job failed (timeout or provider error). It is not counted as failing.
